# Inner Spirit Studio

> Global network of wellness, movement, and conscious-living sanctuaries — a yoga and sound-healing studio in Bogotá, a volunteer-built land project in Portugal, and a Static Dance / conscious-movement hub in Chicago.

Inner Spirit Studio began as a yoga, meditation, and sound-healing sanctuary in La Candelaria, Bogotá, Colombia (4.9★ on Google, 160+ reviews), and has since grown into three linked sanctuaries: the original Bogotá studio, a nascent land and volunteering project on Portugal's Costa de Leiria near Nazaré, and a Static Dance / conscious-movement hub in Chicago, USA. The site is available in Spanish, Portuguese, and English — language is independent of which sanctuary a visitor is browsing.

## Sanctuaries

- [Bogotá, Colombia](https://innerspirit.net/): daily yoga, meditation, sound healing, dance, capoeira, breathwork, a 1:1 therapy consultorio, conscious excursions to Monserrate/Guatavita/La Chorrera, and a curated shop of conscious objects.
- [Portugal (Nazaré / Costa de Leiria)](https://innerspirit.net/portugal): an early-stage land project seeding a future wellness sanctuary; open volunteering program (renovation, garden, community building).
- [Chicago, USA](https://innerspirit.net/chicago): Static Dance — sober, screen-free, barefoot conscious movement in a historic timber loft, with 432Hz live sound healing.

## Explore

- [Classes](https://innerspirit.net/clases): Vinyasa, Hatha, Yin Yoga, meditation, breathwork, sound healing.
- [Events & Rituals](https://innerspirit.net/eventos): Inner Dance, new/full moon ceremonies, sound baths, cacao ceremonies.
- [Consultorio (1:1 sessions)](https://innerspirit.net/consultorio): therapeutic yoga, guided meditation, breathwork, sound healing, art therapy.
- [The Space](https://innerspirit.net/espacio): heritage-house venue rental for workshops, certifications, and conscious-tourism experiences.
- [Community](https://innerspirit.net/comunidad): real Google reviews, live Instagram feed, and how to join Inner Spirit's community circles.
- [Shop](https://innerspirit.net/tienda): quartz crystals, natural incense, essential oils, Tibetan singing bowls, gratitude journals.
- [Journal / Blog](https://innerspirit.net/blog): articles on meditation, yoga, chakras, breathwork, and moon rituals.
- [About](https://innerspirit.net/nosotros): the studio's story and mission.
- [Contact](https://innerspirit.net/contacto): location, WhatsApp, email, and hours.
